# cost-running

> Measure the real cost of running code — money, time, energy, carbon, water — with a mandatory honesty taxonomy.

## What it is

cost-running is a Python library and CLI tool (BSD-3-Clause) for computing the wide-sense cost of running a piece of code.
"Wide-sense" means: money, wall-clock time, energy, CO2 equivalent emissions, and water.

Every numeric quantity in a cost model carries one of four honesty statuses:
- measured — recorded from an actual run on the target system
- estimated — derived from sourced assumptions, with a source URL and retrieval date
- placeholder — a structural stand-in; not a real number
- TODO — a human must supply this before the model can be trusted

A weakest-link rule propagates: a derived value can never claim a stronger status than the worst of its inputs.

## Key CLI commands

```
cost-running audit <path|github-url>   # detect languages, archetype, paid services → scaffold model
cost-running measure -- python train.py  # measure a representative run (RAPL / getrusage)
cost-running validate cost_of_running.yaml
cost-running render cost_of_running.yaml --format html --output report.html
cost-running diff old.yaml new.yaml    # drift gate (exit 1 if any dim changed >10%)
cost-running catalog scrape            # fetch public leaderboard benchmarks (HF Open LLM, Arena)
```
